product.name: Thorntale AI
product.description: An AI-powered presentation assistant that helps create, edit, and proofread slide decks within Thorntale.

product.name: Thorntale Charts
product.description: A charting engine that creates professional, responsive, and brand-aligned data visualizations within presentations.

product.name: Presentation Templates
product.description: A collection of customizable slide templates to help users start and style presentations efficiently.

product.name: Deck Organization Tools
product.description: Features that help users group, navigate, and manage multiple presentation decks efficiently.

product.name: Google Slides Import
product.description: A feature that imports Google Slides presentations into Thorntale by semantically translating slide content.

product.name: Email Integration
product.description: Enables sending presentation decks as formatted, interactive emails directly from Thorntale.
